text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking with Satono Diamond, I spotted Gold Ship with an unusually serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Around this much?
No, more of a capacity like...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Deep in thought, Golshi-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Satono, huh... Fine, I'll tell ya.
Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, does looking at this pool make you think of anything?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Umm... "Thank you for all your help with my training as always"?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Also... hmm...
It might be more fun if it were a bit bigger.
The pool I swam in overseas was vast and so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well said, Sacchan!
I'm awarding you 564 points!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay, thank you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the capacity of this pool
might just be sufficient for training...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wanna believe in the potential of Umamusume!
I wanna see the sense of freedom in a massive pool,
and the new heights born from it for us Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Golshi-san, to think you had such
a thoughtful consideration for all Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's why I made up my mind... I'm going to—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna turn this pool into the Sea of Okhotsk!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sea of Okhotsk! ...Sea of Okhotsk?
What exactly does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We just gotta move the Sea of Okhotsk into the pool! That way we can train all we want!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible scale...!
Is something like that truly possible?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Probably! If every student does a bucket relay
for like 50 years, we can totally do it!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, regardless of how realistic it is,
I think it is a wonderful ambition.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, listening to your stories
made me super excited!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sato-bo... you really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I also agree with remodeling the pool to make it larger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Golshi-san!
You have my full cooperation!
choice_data_list: You're already well-trained as it is.
Let's pour all our feelings into the academy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But if we remodel it,
it'll create a much better environment than what we have now, you know?
choice_data_list: Are we really going to spend our precious time doing a bucket relay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
Y-You're right...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bummer... If you put it that way,
I can't really force ya.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
However, one day, I'll make it happen.
Until the day we rise up, let us sharpen our fangs.
...On a daikon radish grater.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two shared a firm handshake. When the time for uprising comes...
I'll persuade her to stand down again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In that case... how about we draw up a formal proposal?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that a great idea!
It's way easier to convince 'em if we got a concrete plan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, this is starting to get fun♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The "Tracen Academy Pool: Sea of Okhotsk Transformation Project" is now underway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, the project didn't come to fruition, but it proved to be a valuable experience for Satono Diamond!
